findings.title: "Date" mixes date formats
findings.detail: 2 of 8 values are written differently from the rest, so the column is being treated as text.
findings.why: While this stays text, every chart sorts these values alphabetically instead of chronologically.

actions.label: Read them all as dates
actions.consequence: Converts the column to a real date. Values that still cannot be read become blank, and the count is reported.

findings.title: "CustomerEmail" has malformed email addresses
findings.detail: 2 of 7 values do not look like valid email addresses.
findings.why: Malformed contact details fail silently at the point you try to use them.

findings.title: "ProductName" has gaps
findings.why: Missing values are silently skipped by most calculations, which quietly changes every total and average.

actions.label: Label them "Unknown"
actions.consequence: Sets 1 blank value to "Unknown", keeping the rows in every count.

actions.label: Fill with the most common value
actions.consequence: Sets 1 blank value to "Widget A". This invents data, so use it only when that is genuinely the default.

actions.label: Delete these rows
actions.consequence: Permanently removes 1 row (12.5% of the table), including whatever those rows held in every other column.

findings.title: "Category" spells the same value several ways
findings.detail: 1 value differ from another value only by capitalisation or spacing (for example "Electronics" and " Electronics").
findings.why: Each spelling becomes its own bar, slice and group, splitting one real category into several.

actions.label: Merge them to the most common spelling
actions.consequence: Each set of variants adopts whichever spelling appears most often, so acronyms like USA are preserved. No rows are removed.

findings.title: "Price" has gaps
findings.why: Missing values are silently skipped by most calculations, which quietly changes every total and average.

actions.label: Fill with the median
actions.consequence: Sets 1 blank value to 25.5. No rows are removed.

actions.label: Fill with the average
actions.consequence: Sets 1 blank value to 1465.641429. Outliers pull this figure around.

actions.label: Delete these rows
actions.consequence: Permanently removes 1 row (12.5% of the table), including whatever those rows held in every other column.

findings.title: "CustomerEmail" has gaps
findings.why: Rows without an identifier cannot be linked to any other table, so they drop out of every join.

actions.label: Delete these rows

findings.title: "CustomerPhone" has malformed phone numbers
findings.detail: 1 of 7 values do not look like valid phone numbers.
findings.why: Malformed contact details fail silently at the point you try to use them.

findings.title: "ProductName" has padded values
findings.detail: 1 value have spaces at the start or end.
findings.why: "Delhi" and "Delhi " count as two different groups in every chart and never match in a join.

actions.label: Trim the spaces
actions.consequence: Removes surrounding spaces from 1 value. No rows are removed and no other text changes.
